tooltip.reliquified_artifacts.mimi_dust: When used on a chest, it transforms it into a mimic that drops as many random relics as it originally contained before the transformation.
relics.description.umbrella.description: At first glance, it looks like the most ordinary travel umbrella: worn fabric, creaking ribs, and a handle polished by long wanderings. But the moment the wind catches its canopy, the air itself begins to obey its owner. The umbrella gently slows the fall, allowing one to glide along the currents as if stepping on invisible stairs.
relics.description.umbrella.ability.glid: While the umbrella is held in hand, it limits the holder's falling speed to %4$s.

Pressing LMB while falling with the umbrella in hand propels the relic holder in the direction opposite to where they are looking with a force of %2$s and consumes 1 of %1$s charges. Charges are restored as soon as the relic holder touches the ground.
Using a bounce while falling grants the relic holder the Vanishing effect for %3$s seconds.
+1 experience for each bounce while falling.
+1 experience for each block traveled during slowed fall.
relics.description.umbrella.ability.shie: Holding RMB allows the umbrella to be used as a full-fledged shield. It blocks up to %1$s hits in a row, after which it goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds.
On a successful block, knocks the attacking target back by %2$s blocks.
relics.description.snorkel.description: A breathing tube darkened by salt, the kind worn by seekers of sunken treasures and hunters of sea mysteries. Its narrow passage seems to carry air deeper than should be possible, allowing its owner to remain underwater longer. With it, diving ceases to be a race for the last breath, and the water itself feels calm and obedient.
relics.description.snorkel.ability.snork: Allows breathing underwater if there are no more than %1$s blocks of water between the relic holder and air.
When going below a safe depth, once before returning to a safe zone, grants Water Breathing for %2$s seconds.
Removes underwater fog and noticeably improves visibility underwater.
+1 experience for each air bubble spent underwater.
+1 experience for each unique Water Breathing effect gained.
Time spent at a safe underwater depth
An oddball hat with two curved tubes, once invented for rowdy parties and endless toasts. Over time, however, it proved far more useful on the road than at a feast. With it, flasks, potions, and any drinks can be emptied almost on the run, without breaking away from battle or losing a second for a breather.
Speeds up the use of all drinks by %1$s%%.
+1 experience for each point of air restored by drinking.
+1 experience for each consumed drink item.
+1 experience for each point of health restored by drinking.
+1 experience for each point of hunger restored by drinking.
An oddball hat with two curved tubes, once invented for rowdy parties and endless toasts. Over time, however, it proved far more useful on the road than at a feast. With it, flasks, potions, and any drinks can be emptied almost on the run, without breaking away from battle or losing a second for a breather.
Speeds up the use of all drinks by %1$s%%.
+1 experience for each point of air restored by drinking.
+1 experience for each consumed drink item.
+1 experience for each point of health restored by drinking.
+1 experience for each point of hunger restored by drinking.
Heavy goggles fitted with a set of carefully polished lenses, made for those used to working where light never lingers long. Their glass catches even the faintest glimmers and turns darkness into a clear outline of the world. In the hands of an experienced wearer, they do more than restore sight at night — they make darkness itself an ally.
The ability is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
In darkness, increases the damage dealt by the relic holder up to %3$s%%. The bonus scales with the surrounding darkness level: it is small in dim light and reaches its maximum in complete darkness.
Removes fog and haze, greatly improving visibility.

In darkness, gives attackers up to a %2$s%% chance to miss the relic holder. The chance scales with the darkness level around the holder: it is small in dim light and reaches its maximum in complete darkness.
+1 experience for every 5 blocks moved in darkness while the mode is active.
Damage avoided by dodging in darkness
relics.description.cowboy_hat.descriptio: A worn wide-brimmed hat of the kind ridden by horsemen of endless plains. Its leather has darkened from the sun and long journeys, and its brim still holds the dust of old roads. They say such hats are worn by those who spend more time in the saddle than on the ground — and so any mount beneath them moves more confidently, more quickly, and obeys the slightest movement of the reins.
relics.description.cowboy_hat.ability.ri: While the holder is riding a mount, its stats are increased by %1$s%%.
While riding, the holder gains %3$s absorption.
Riding increases attack range and block interaction range by %2$s%%.
+1 experience for every 10 blocks traveled while riding a mount.
relics.description.villager_hat.descript: A simple-looking straw hat with a neat ribbon — the mark of someone trusted in villages. Under its brim, trading comes easier and common ground with villagers is quickly found, while iron golems look upon its owner as someone worth protecting. They say such a hat belongs only to those who have earned a good name in many markets.
Iron golems do not attack the relic holder and stand in their defense.
Reduces incoming damage by %1$s%% for each iron golem within %2$s blocks, up to a maximum of %3$s%%.
+1 experience for each damage distribution trigger from Golem Guard.
Damage reduced thanks to iron golems
Reduces the cost of trades with villagers by %1$s%%.
Trading can add up to %2$s additional trade results.
With a %3$s%% chance, a trade does not consume stock from the villager's current offer.
+1 experience for each additional trade result.
+1 experience for each trade with a villager.
relics.description.anglers_hat.descripti: A battered angler's hat soaked in salt, wind, and the patience of long waits by the water. Its brim is sun-bleached, and the fabric still carries the smell of rivers and sea coves. They say seasoned fishermen never come ashore without such a hat — with it, the line pulls heavier, the catch grows richer, and sometimes something far more valuable than ordinary fish rises from the depths.
relics.description.anglers_hat.ability.c: Each successful catch is additionally multiplied up to %4$s times with a %1$s%% chance.
Instead of fish, a treasure can be caught with a %3$s%% chance.
relics.description.lucky_scarf.descripti: A thin scarf of prospectors and vein-seekers, faded by stone dust and long days underground. They say its threads are woven so as to pull rare luck straight from the ore. Where others find only a barren vein, the owner of such a scarf often draws a far more generous harvest from the rock.
relics.description.lucky_scarf.ability.f: When mining ores and other fortune-dependent blocks, has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional Fortune level up to %2$s activations.
Each successful activation increases the activation limit for the next block by %4$s.
Each block mined without bonus drops builds a hidden %3$s%% chance for the next activation.
If there are nearby blocks of the same type, the activation chance is additionally increased by %5$s%% for each such block.
+1 experience for each additional Fortune level.
relics.description.lucky_scarf.synergy.c: Grants the Luck effect of level %1$s, increasing the quality of loot found in chests.
relics.description.charm_of_shrinking.de: A small amulet with a crystal in which the world is reflected slightly distorted, as if seen through poorly polished glass. Those who wore it long enough noticed something strange: the space around them seemed to change its attitude toward the owner's body. Footsteps grew quieter, falls gentler, and the wearer could alter their own scale, as if the world briefly forgot what size they were supposed to be.
relics.description.charm_of_shrinking.ab: Increases the chance to evade damage by %6$s%% for each unit of size reduction.
Reduces fall damage by %3$s%% for each unit of size reduction.
Causes mobs within %5$s blocks to lose sight of the relic holder with a %4$s%% chance for each unit of size reduction.
+1 experience for each point of fall damage prevented.
+1 experience for every 5 seconds spent moving in shrink mode.
Gradually returns the relic holder's size to normal at a rate of %2$s per second.
Gradually shrinks the relic holder down to %1$s at a rate of %2$s per second.
Locks the relic holder's current size.
relics.description.obsidian_skull.descri: A heavy skull carved from a single piece of obsidian and blackened by the heat of the Nether depths. Its surface stays warm even in the cold, and a dry ashen air seems to drift from its empty eye sockets. They say this skull was worn by those unafraid to step into molten rivers, and under its power even lava itself ceases, for a time, to be deadly.
relics.description.obsidian_skull.abilit: Allows staying in lava without taking damage for up to %1$s seconds in a row. Outside lava, this time reserve gradually recovers each second.
When 75%% of the time reserve is spent, movement speed in lava is increased by %2$s%% until the ability effect ends.
The relic holder takes no fall damage when landing in lava.
While the relic holder is in lava with the ability effect active, incoming damage is reduced by %3$s%%.
+1 experience for each second spent in lava under the ability effect.
+1 experience for each safe fall into lava.
Time spent in lava under the effect
Safe falls into lava from Rank 1
relics.description.superstitious_hat.des: A bright, slightly faded hat with curled brims and a worn ribbon, reminiscent of the headwear associated with leprechauns and other spirits of fortune. It is worn by those who believe that rich loot favors only the bold.
relics.description.superstitious_hat.abi: When killing mobs, has a %1$s%% chance to apply an additional Looting level up to %8$s activations.
For animals, provides a constant %4$s bonus to Looting level.
The first kill after a pause of %2$s seconds gains an additional %3$s%% chance to activate the ability.
If no more than %5$s seconds pass between kills, the activation chance increases by %6$s%% for each subsequent kill, up to %7$s times.
+1 experience for each additional Looting modifier activation.
relics.description.scarf_of_invisibility: A light dark scarf woven from unusual fabric that seems to blur the boundary between body and air. When its wearer stands still, the threads begin to tremble softly, and the silhouette gradually dissolves into the surrounding world.

If the relic holder stands still for more than %1$s seconds, they gain the Vanishing effect. The ability is interrupted by any interaction with the world, and it cannot be reactivated for at least %2$s seconds, provided there are no creatures nearby that consider the grok their target.
While Vanishing is active, the relic holder restores %5$s health per second.
The first attack after leaving Vanishing deals %3$s%% more damage.
The first attack after leaving Vanishing stuns the target for %4$s seconds
+1 experience for each attack from invisibility.
+1 experience for each time entering and leaving invisibility.
Stun time from attacks out of invisibility
relics.description.cross_necklace.descri: A time-darkened cross talisman, the kind worn by pilgrims and wandering hunters of the undead. Its metal bears traces of old prayers and survived battles. They say that in the hardest moment, it takes part of the blow upon itself, granting its owner a brief instant that is sometimes enough to survive what should have been the last.
relics.description.cross_necklace.abilit: After taking damage, increases the holder's invulnerability window by %1$s seconds.
Undead attacking the holder are set on fire for %2$s seconds
With a %4$s%% chance, cancels fatal damage.
Increases damage dealt to undead by %3$s%%.
+1 experience for each point of damage received when fatal damage is canceled.
+1 experience for each hit on undead.
relics.description.panic_necklace.descri: A small amulet on a thin chain, with a tiny crystal trembling inside as if sensing hostile intent. The more eyes are fixed on its owner, the stronger the amulet responds — the heart beats faster, and the body fills with nervous, life-saving energy.
relics.description.panic_necklace.abilit: Increases movement speed by %1$s%% for each mob within %2$s blocks that considers the relic holder its target. The bonus cannot exceed %3$s%%.
Increases attack speed by %6$s%% for each mob that considers the relic holder its target.
When a mob that considered the relic holder its target dies, restores %4$s health.
Reduces incoming damage by %5$s%% if there are no mobs in sight that consider the relic holder their target.
+1 experience for taking damage from a mob that considers the relic holder its target.
+1 experience for the death of a mob that considered the relic holder its target.
Damage absorbed while no targets are in sight
Health restored when a target dies in sight
relics.description.shock_pendant.descrip: A pendant with a cracked crystal inside which thin electrical discharges constantly flicker. The stone keenly responds to hostile strikes, storing energy and instantly releasing it outward again. The moment an enemy touches the wearer, the crystal answers with a chain of bright sparks leaping from target to target.
relics.description.shock_pendant.ability: When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to release an electric spark that jumps between targets up to %3$s times within %2$s blocks, dealing %4$s damage to each.
The spark deals %5$s%% more damage in water or rain.
Grants complete immunity to lightning damage.
When the holder takes damage, has a %6$s%% chance to inflict Tremor on the attacker for %7$s seconds
+1 experience for each lightning strike survived.
relics.description.flame_pendant.descrip: A pendant with a fiery crystal, inside which a bright flame smolders endlessly. The stone holds the heat of a blacksmith's forge and responds to hostile strikes with a burst of fire. The moment an opponent touches the wearer, the crystal answers with tongues of flame, turning the fury of battle into a blazing counterattack.
relics.description.flame_pendant.ability: When taking damage, has a %1$s%% chance to ignite the attacking target for %2$s seconds
Damage dealt to burning targets is increased by %3$s%%.
While the holder is burning, they restore %4$s health per second.
Grants complete immunity to fire damage.
+1 experience for each hit on a burning target.
+1 experience for each target ignited by the ability.
Bonus damage dealt to burning targets
Target burn time from the ability
relics.description.thorn_pendant.descrip: A pendant entwined with thin emerald thorns through which thick poison slowly circulates. The stone reacts sharply to aggression: the moment a blow lands on its wearer, the thorns answer in kind. Enemies quickly learn that every attack against the owner of such an amulet brings painful payback.
relics.description.thorn_pendant.ability: When the holder takes damage, %1$s%% of it is returned to the attacking target.
Damage dealt to poisoned targets is increased by %4$s%%.
Reflected damage inflicts Poison level %3$s on the target for %2$s sec.
Grants complete immunity to poison damage.
+1 experience for each hit on a poisoned target.
Total duration of target poisoning from Rank 1
Bonus damage dealt to poisoned targets
relics.description.charm_of_sinking.desc: An amulet with a dense blue stone inside which a dark watery depth slowly stirs. Its weight seems to pull the owner downward, toward the very bottom. Where others lack air and strength, the wearer feels steadier — as if the water itself becomes their protection.
relics.description.charm_of_sinking.abil: When the relic holder stands on the bottom underwater, their air supply stops decreasing and begins to refill at a rate of %1$s% units per second.
Allows the holder to move freely in water.
If the relic holder stands motionless on the bottom underwater for more than %3$s seconds, they gain Immortality, which lasts until their first movement.
While in water, reduces incoming damage by %2$s%% for each block of water above the holder's head.
+1 experience for each air bubble restored.
+1 experience for each point of damage reduced by blocks of water above the holder's head.
Damage reduced by blocks of water above the holder's head
relics.description.antidote_vessel.descr: A small sealed vessel filled with a clear elixir in which purifying particles slowly spin. Its contents react to poisons and curses, weakening their influence before they can fully take hold. Those who carry such a vessel endure toxic blows more easily and shake off harmful effects faster.
relics.description.antidote_vessel.abili: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to the relic holder by %1$s%%.
The strength of negative effects on the relic holder cannot exceed level 1.
After a negative effect ends, the relic holder gains protection against reapplying that same effect for %3$s seconds.
Reduces incoming damage to the relic holder by %2$s%% for each active negative effect.
+1 experience for each negative effect received.
Damage reduced thanks to the number of negative effects
relics.description.universal_attractor.d: A compact field generator that creates a controllable force field around its owner. By changing polarity, the device makes loot and other objects either rush toward the holder or scatter away.
relics.description.universal_attractor.a: The ability is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
Pulls all nearby items within %1$s blocks toward the relic holder.
Pushes all nearby items within %1$s blocks away from the relic holder.
In pull mode, additionally pulls experience orbs.
In push mode, additionally repels hostile projectiles.
Instead of moving smoothly in pull mode, items instantly teleport to the relic holder.
+1 experience for each pulled experience orb.
relics.description.crystal_heart.descrip: A crystal cut into the shape of a heart, with a soft crimson light pulsing inside. Its energy temporarily strengthens the owner's life force, expanding the limits of the body's endurance.
relics.description.crystal_heart.ability: Increases the relic holder's maximum health by %1$s. If current health falls below this value, the bonus temporarily disappears and the ability goes on cooldown for %2$s seconds, after which the additional health reserve is restored.
While the relic holder's health is full, incoming damage is reduced by %3$s%%.
Healing received while below the bonus reserve threshold is increased by %4$s%%.
If an incoming hit exceeds %5$s%% of the relic holder's maximum health, they gain Immortality for %6$s seconds.
+1 experience for each point of health restored from the additional reserve granted by the ability.
+1 experience for each activation of Immortality.
relics.description.cloud_in_a_bottle.des: A transparent bottle with a tiny cloud lazily swirling inside. When its owner pushes off the air, the sealed current lifts them upward, as if an invisible step appears beneath their feet. Such a bottle lets one keep moving even where there has long been no ground below.
relics.description.cloud_in_a_bottle.abi: Allows the relic holder to perform up to %1$s additional jumps in the air.
Hitting a target during a series of air jumps restores 1 additional jump.
After performing an additional jump, reduces the relic holder's falling speed for %2$s seconds.
If the relic holder looks upward during an additional jump, their vertical thrust is increased by %3$s%%.
+1 experience for each additional air jump.
+1 experience for each combat recovery activation.
Bonus damage dealt thanks to restored additional jumps
relics.description.cloud_in_a_bottle.syn: Each additional jump has a %1$s%% chance to automatically trigger the Whoopee Cushion.
relics.description.helium_flamingo.descr: A bright inflatable flamingo filled with light gas and peculiar inventor's logic. The moment the holder jumps, the bird lifts them into the air, allowing them to move through the sky as if it had become a calm sheet of water.
relics.description.helium_flamingo.abili: After a double jump, allows the relic holder to hover freely in the air for up to %1$s seconds. Flight speed depends on the holder's swimming speed and is additionally increased by %2$s%%.
Ranged attacks made while hovering deal %3$s%% more damage.
While hovering, incoming damage to the relic holder is reduced by %4$s%%.
Hover time is not consumed if the relic holder is barely moving.
+1 experience for each second of hovering.
Bonus damage dealt by ranged attacks while hovering
relics.description.running_shoes.descrip: A pair of lightweight running shoes made for those who rely on speed. Their soles seem to catch motion and turn an ordinary run into steadily building acceleration. The longer the owner keeps the pace, the swifter their step becomes, until inertia itself begins to work for them.
relics.description.running_shoes.ability: During continuous running, gradually increases the relic holder's movement speed up to %1$s%%. After stopping, the accumulated acceleration gradually dissipates.
Upon reaching maximum speed, the relic holder gains Immortality.
Jumping while running speeds up acceleration gain by %3$s%%, reducing the time required to reach maximum speed.
Increases automatic step-up height to %2$s blocks. The value grows with current acceleration and reaches its maximum at top speed.
+1 experience for every 5 seconds of continuous running.
+1 experience for each jump while running.
Time spent in the Immortality state
relics.description.snowshoes.description: A pair of wide snowshoes that distribute weight as if a snowy plain were turning into a solid road. They allow one to move across drifts confidently and without extra effort, keeping up the pace even where ordinary steps would sink into the snow.
relics.description.snowshoes.ability.sno: Increases the relic holder's movement speed on snow by %1$s%%.
Grants the relic holder immunity to freezing.
After leaving snow, the speed bonus remains for %2$s more seconds.
Allows the relic holder to move freely on powder snow without sinking.
+1 experience for every 5 seconds of movement on snow.
relics.description.steadfast_spikes.desc: A set of sturdy spikes attached to the soles and biting into the surface with every step. They hold the wearer steady where ordinary footwear would slip and lose traction, allowing balance to be maintained even on smooth ice.
relics.description.steadfast_spikes.abil: Increases resistance to knockback and slippery surfaces by %1$s%%.
While the relic holder stands still, they cannot be moved.
While sneaking, the ability's effectiveness is doubled.
Allows the relic holder to slow their fall by sliding down vertical surfaces.
The ability is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
While the relic holder is sliding down a wall, incoming damage is reduced by %1$s%%.
+1 experience for each second spent in the wall slide state.
relics.description.flippers.description: A pair of flexible flippers made for swift movement in water. They enhance every stroke, allowing the wearer to cut through the water faster and with greater agility.
relics.description.flippers.ability.swim: Increases the relic holder's swimming speed by %1$s%%.
While the relic holder is in water, their air supply is consumed %2$s%% more slowly.
Underwater, gravity no longer affects the relic holder.
Allows attacks to miss the relic holder with a %3$s%% chance while they are underwater.
+1 experience for every 5 seconds of swimming.
+1 experience for each missed hit against the relic holder underwater.
Misses against the relic holder underwater
Damage prevented thanks to misses underwater
relics.description.rooted_boots.descript: Boots with a living root network woven into their soles. The moment the wearer steps on grass, the roots briefly grow into the earth, drawing nourishment from it.
Consumes the grass block beneath the relic holder, turning it into dirt and restoring %1$s hunger and %2$s saturation. After activation, the ability goes on cooldown for %3$s seconds.
Once every %6$s seconds, applies a bonemeal effect to the plant beneath the relic holder.
When the ability activates, additionally restores %5$s health to the relic holder.
The transformed dirt turns back into grass no later than %4$s seconds later.
+1 experience for each grass block consumed.
+1 experience for each growth effect applied.
relics.description.aqua_dashers.descript: Light running shoes that create an elastic watery support beneath the soles. With each step, the water's surface briefly becomes solid, allowing the wearer to glide over it as if on a road. The first steps are slower, but motion quickly restores full pace.
While running, allows the relic holder to move freely across the water's surface. Upon stepping onto water, movement speed is temporarily reduced by %1$s%% and gradually returns to normal over %2$s seconds.
Allows moving on the water's surface without needing to run.
While the relic holder moves across the water's surface, hostile projectiles pass through them.
Jumps on the water's surface become %3$s%% higher.
+1 experience for every 5 seconds of movement on the water's surface.
+1 experience for each boosted jump on the water's surface.
+1 experience for each ignored projectile while moving on the water's surface.
Time spent on the water's surface
Boosted jumps performed on the water's surface
Projectiles ignored while moving on the water's surface
relics.description.strider_shoes.descrip: Heat-resistant footwear with soles capable of withstanding even molten stone. With every step, the lava beneath briefly hardens, allowing the wearer to move confidently across its surface. The first steps come slowly, but soon movement returns to its usual speed.
relics.description.strider_shoes.ability: While sneaking, allows the relic holder to move freely across the surface of lava. Upon stepping onto lava, movement speed is temporarily reduced by %1$s%% and gradually returns to normal over %2$s seconds.
While the relic holder is moving across the surface of lava, they gain complete immunity to fire damage.
Allows moving across the surface of lava without needing to sneak.
Jumps on the surface of lava become %3$s%% higher.
+1 experience for every 5 seconds of movement on the surface of lava.
+1 experience for each boosted jump on the surface of lava.
Time spent on the surface of lava
Boosted jumps performed on the surface of lava
relics.description.whoopee_cushion.descr: A prank cushion with a small gas mechanism hidden inside. The moment the owner awkwardly sits down, the device releases a powerful burst of air accompanied by a loud sound. What looks like a silly joke is, in fact, capable of much more...
relics.description.whoopee_cushion.abili: When sneaking once, has a %1$s%% chance to play its signature sound and push all targets around the relic holder up to %2$s blocks away.
When the ability activates, all targets within %4$s blocks are paralyzed for %5$s seconds.
The ability can also activate when taking damage, with a %3$s%% chance.
When the ability activates, there is a %6$s%% chance that a gas cloud remains behind, poisoning targets, inflicting nausea, and causing creatures inside it to lose sight of the relic holder.
relics.description.vampiric_glove.descri: A dark glove threaded with thin crimson veins that flare with every strike. It drains life force from wounded enemies and channels it back to its owner. The fiercer the battle, the more the glove is saturated with stolen energy.
relics.description.vampiric_glove.abilit: The relic holder's attacks restore health equal to %1$s%% of the damage dealt.
Killing a target additionally restores %5$s%% of the relic holder's maximum health.
Excess healing beyond maximum health is converted into absorption, up to a maximum of %6$s.
The effectiveness of healing from the ability increases by %2$s%% for each attack made no later than %3$s seconds after the previous one. The bonus can stack up to %4$s times.
+1 experience for each point of health restored by the ability.
relics.description.golden_hook.descripti: A gilded hook meant for those who gather not only trophies, but every scrap of experience as well. Its metal seems to reach for the energy of fallen enemies, making dropped experience orbs find their owner faster and yield more power.
relics.description.golden_hook.ability.h: Increases the amount of experience the relic holder gains for killing targets by %1$s%%.
Experience orbs within %2$s blocks are automatically attracted to the relic holder.
Attacking a target slightly pulls nearby creatures within %3$s blocks toward it.
With a %4$s%% chance, knocks the item out of the attacked target's hands.
+1 experience for each activation of bonus experience drops.
+1 experience for each item knocked out of a target's hands.
Items knocked out of targets' hands
relics.description.onion_ring.descriptio: A bracelet with a pungent onion scent that somehow links satiety with the strength of a pickaxe strike. As long as the stomach is full, the body works faster and more tirelessly, turning the mining of stone and ore into a relentless, greedy rhythm.
relics.description.onion_ring.ability.hu: Increases block mining speed by %1$s%% for each point of the relic holder's saturation.
After eating food, mining speed is additionally increased by %2$s%% for %3$s seconds.
At maximum saturation, blocks are destroyed instantly.
Destroying blocks has a %4$s%% chance to restore 1 hunger.
+1 experience for each mined block with a 10%% chance.
+1 experience for each point of hunger restored by the ability.
relics.description.digging_claws.descrip: A pair of reinforced claws made for rapidly carving through stone and earth. Their blades bite into rock with astonishing ease, turning block mining into a relentless and aggressive push forward.
relics.description.digging_claws.ability: Block mining speed without a tool is increased by %2$s%%.
Increases the relic holder's Fortune level by 1.
Continuous mining of blocks destroyed no later than %4$s seconds after the previous one increases destruction speed by %3$s%% for each subsequent block.
+1 experience for each mined block with a 10%% chance.
relics.description.power_glove.descripti: A heavy combat glove that stores energy between strikes and unleashes it in rare but devastating bursts of force. When the charge reaches its peak, the blow crashes down on the enemy with unimaginable power.
relics.description.power_glove.ability.p: Power Strike ignores %3$s%% of the target's armor.
If a Power Strike kills the target, the next attack also counts as a Power Strike.
Power Strike breaks through the target's shields.
+1 experience for a kill made with a Power Strike that executes the target.
relics.description.withered_bracelet.des: A dark bracelet infused with the energy of withering. Its cold glow leaves the skin with a sensation of dry heat, and each strike from its wearer may pass devastating decay on to the enemy.
relics.description.withered_bracelet.abi: The relic holder's attacks have a %1$s%% chance to inflict Wither level %3$s on the target for %2$s seconds.
Each tick of Wither damage restores health to the relic holder equal to the damage dealt.
Grants the relic holder complete immunity to Wither damage.
If the target dies while affected by Wither, the effect spreads to all creatures within %5$s blocks for %4$s seconds.
+1 experience for each application of Wither to a new target.
relics.description.warp_drive.descriptio: A compact warp module synchronized with the energy of the ender pearl. The device intercepts the moment of teleportation and stabilizes it.
relics.description.warp_drive.ability.wa: Using an ender pearl no longer consumes it, but after teleportation applies a cooldown of %1$s seconds.
After teleportation, all targets within %2$s blocks are blinded for %3$s seconds and lose sight of the relic holder.
Teleportation using an ender pearl no longer deals damage to the relic holder.
The ender pearl loses gravity and flies in a straight line.
+1 experience for each target blinded after teleportation.
+1 experience for each use of an ender pearl.
Damage prevented from ender pearl teleportation
relics.description.kitty_slippers.descri: A pair of soft slippers with cat faces on them, giving off a strange but very convincing aura. Monsters sense the presence of a predator in them and prefer to keep their distance, while the owner moves more quietly and lightly. They say these slippers sometimes grant their master another chance — as if they truly had more than one life.
relics.description.kitty_slippers.abilit: Creepers and phantoms within %1$s blocks avoid the relic holder as if a cat were nearby.
The relic holder moves %2$s%% faster while sneaking.
With a %1$s%% chance, fatal damage does not kill the relic holder, leaving them at 1 health.
After taking damage, the next attack against the relic holder has a %3$s%% chance to miss.
+1 experience for each point of damage survived when the lifesaving effect activates.
+1 experience for each missed attack against the relic holder.
Missed attacks against the relic holder
relics.description.bunny_hoppers.descrip: A pair of soft bunny-shaped slippers with springy soles. One jump is enough for them to launch the wearer high upward, turning an ordinary leap into a prolonged vertical burst. Such slippers are especially useful for mobile combat and unexpected attacks from above.
relics.description.bunny_hoppers.ability: While holding the jump key, allows the relic holder to perform a high jump lasting up to %1$s seconds.
While the relic holder is airborne after a high jump, damage dealt is increased by %3$s%% for each block of height gained upward.
When performing the jump, pushes away nearby targets within %2$s blocks.
Landing after a high jump does not deal fall damage.
+0.1 experience for each unit of jump height.
+1 experience for each hit on a target while falling after a high jump.
Bonus damage dealt while falling after a jump
relics.description.feral_claws.descripti: A pair of predatory claws made for relentless and furious assault. With every precise strike, they stir the hunter's instinct, speeding up the owner's movements and turning a sequence of attacks into a mounting combat frenzy.
relics.description.feral_claws.ability.f: Each attack made no later than %1$s seconds after the previous one increases attack speed by %3$s%% and adds 1 charge. The number of charges cannot exceed %2$s.
If there is a pause between attacks, charges begin to fade gradually — 1 charge per second.
The relic holder's attacks reduce the target's invulnerability time by %4$s%%.
Taking damage resets the timer before charge loss begins.
relics.description.pocket_piston.descrip: A compact piston mechanism built into a combat glove. With every movement, it projects a hidden impulse, allowing its wearer to reach farther than usual and confidently control the space around them.
relics.description.pocket_piston.ability: Increases attack range and block interaction range by %1$s%%.
Damage dealt and mining speed are increased by %3$s%% for each block of distance to the target.
An attack performed near maximum range stuns the target for %4$s seconds.
Bare-handed attacks knock the target back by %2$s blocks.
+1 experience for each attack performed beyond standard range.
+1 experience for each block broken beyond standard range.
+1 experience for each block placed beyond standard range.
Bonus damage dealt thanks to distance
relics.description.fire_gauntlet.descrip: A combat gauntlet with a red-hot core that flares with every strike. Its touch leaves tongues of flame on enemies, and a prolonged fight quickly turns the battlefield into a charred wasteland.
relics.description.fire_gauntlet.ability: The relic holder's attacks ignite the target for %1$s seconds.
Damage dealt to burning targets is increased by %2$s%%.
The death of a creature burning from the ability releases up to %5$s sparks, each dealing %6$s damage and igniting targets for %7$s seconds.
Attacks on burning targets ignite other targets within %3$s blocks for %4$s seconds.
+1 experience for igniting a new target.
+1 experience for each hit by a spark.
relics.description.pickaxe_heater.descri: A compact heating module installed directly into a pickaxe. It instantly heats mined ore, sometimes turning it into a ready ingot at the very moment of mining.
relics.description.pickaxe_heater.abilit: Has a %1$s%% chance to automatically smelt ore blocks when mined.
Attacking with a pickaxe ignites the target for %2$s seconds.
With a %4$s%% chance, applies an additional Fortune level to mined drops, up to %5$s activations.
Each time smelting fails to activate, its activation chance increases by %3$s%% until the next successful activation.
+1 experience for each block automatically smelted.
+1 experience for each target ignited by a pickaxe attack.
+1 experience for each additional Fortune level.
relics.description.chorus_totem.descript: A compact totem powered by chorus energy, tuned for the owner's emergency rescue. When a blow should be the last, the device activates instantly and tears the relic holder out of danger, transporting them to the nearest safe place.
When taking fatal damage, prevents the relic holder's death by teleporting them to a safe spot within 32 blocks. After activation, the ability goes on cooldown for %1$s seconds.
Before teleportation, all targets within %4$s blocks of the trigger point are blinded for %5$s seconds and lose sight of the relic holder.
After the ability activates, health regeneration effectiveness is increased by %2$s%% for %3$s seconds.
After the ability activates, the relic holder gains the Vanishing effect for %6$s seconds.
relics.description.everlasting_beef.desc: A piece of meat of unusual nature: no matter how much is eaten, it restores itself over time. Every bite leaves a mark on it, but the meat gradually regains its shape, allowing the owner to enjoy a small meal again and again.
relics.description.everlasting_beef.abil: Can be used as food, consuming 1 durability for each use. When durability is depleted, the item cannot be used. Durability restores by 1 every %1$s seconds. Maximum durability: %5$s.
With a %3$s%% chance, consuming it does not cost durability.
+1 experience for each point of health restored by the item.
relics.description.eternal_steak.descrip: A steak of unusual nature: no matter how much is eaten, it restores itself over time. Every bite leaves a mark on it, but the meat gradually regains its shape, allowing the owner to enjoy a small meal again and again.
relics.description.eternal_steak.ability: Can be used as food, consuming 1 durability for each use. When durability is depleted, the item cannot be used. Durability restores by 1 every %1$s seconds. Maximum durability: %5$s.
With a %3$s%% chance, consuming it does not cost durability.
+1 experience for each point of health restored by the item.
